fee_notes: Royalty ranges 4.5%-6% of Gross Sales; generally 6% if franchisee has property control. Advertising Contribution is 4% monthly; reduced to 3% for Standard Shops in captured-traffic locations. Area developers pay the greater of FDD-disclosed rates or 6% royalty / 4% ad contribution / $50,000 initial fee.
